subject.title: feat(control-ui): add cron calendar timeline view

question: Should maintainers continue sponsoring this stale external branch as the cron timeline implementation, or close it and keep the feature on https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/40644 for a fresh current-UI implementation?
rationale: The feature idea is tied to an open product request, but the branch is stale against current UI architecture and has correctness blockers that may require reimplementation rather than a small repair.

options.title: Require current-UI rebase
options.body: Keep this PR open only if the author or a maintainer moves it onto `ui/src/pages/cron/*`, preserves status compatibility, and fixes scheduler/status/i18n blockers.

options.title: Close in favor of issue
options.body: Close this stale branch and keep the cron calendar/timeline direction on https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/40644 until someone opens a fresh implementation.

options.title: Manual adoption
options.body: A maintainer can extract the useful timeline design into a new branch, but that should be explicit owner work rather than ClawSweeper repair.

recommendation.title: Require current-UI rebase
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open only if the author or a maintainer moves it onto `ui/src/pages/cron/*`, preserves status compatibility, and fixes scheduler/status/i18n blockers.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Control UI cron page and status-shape commits make steipete the strongest current routing owner for the product/rebase choice.
